title: qxmd218: Marks-like View Settings holds all practice toolbars
body: Practice: only Settings gear on chrome. Question View Settings (Marks cards) holds Notes & Solutions, Practice Experience, Tools (Theme/All Q/Palette/Bookmark/Group/Fullscreen/Report/Note), Peer Insights. Wired to same actions. Examgoal+Allen. SOLUTION neat. Prev|Check|Next. Quantrex brand.
